dataset_releases: AHRQ MEPS HC-256: 2024 Full Year Consolidated Data File (released August 2026)

burden_domains.label: Economic / healthcare burden

measures.label: Represented population with operational current Long COVID
measures.interval_type: 95% t CI (Taylor linearization; df=159 from full PERSON / PERWT24F survey design)
measures.denominator: MEPS 2024 adults age 18-64 at AGE31X with classifiable route-aware Round 3/1 Long-COVID/current status
measures.universe: U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized population, adults age 18-64
measures.system_boundary: National descriptive population estimate
measures.allowed_interpretation: Survey-weighted number of status-classifiable U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized adults age 18-64 meeting the documented operational Round 3/1 2024 current-Long-COVID rule.
limitations: COVSYMNOW31 wording refers to COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms now; use is conditional on route-aware established Long-COVID history.
AGE31X anchors age to the same Round 3/1 interview; AGE24X is diagnostic only.
Structural PE skips are interpreted by questionnaire routing; RF/DK and unexpected downstream inapplicability remain unresolved.
The represented-population estimate is restricted to status-classifiable respondents; unresolved current-Long-COVID status is excluded from the estimator and is not imputed as case or noncase.
measures.source_locator: HC-256 PANEL + AGE31X + COVIDEVER31 + LCEVER31 + COVSYMNOW31; https://meps.ahrq.gov/data_stats/download_data/pufs/h256/h256doc.shtml#2.5.5
measures.statistics_method: 95% t CI (Taylor linearization; df=159 from full PERSON / PERWT24F survey design)
measures.cohort_definition: Operational current Long COVID at the common Round 3/1 2024 interview: adults age 18-64 by AGE31X with positive MEPS person weight, route-aware established Long-COVID history from COVIDEVER31/LCEVER31 questionnaire routing, and COVSYMNOW31 equal to Yes. Structural -1 values are interpreted by routing; RF/DK and unexpected downstream inapplicability remain unresolved. Round-53 status is diagnostic only and never overwrites the primary 2024 anchor.

measures.label: Gross annual all-cause medical spending
measures.interval_type: 95% t CI (Taylor linearization; df=159 from full PERSON / PERWT24F survey design)
measures.denominator: Adults age 18-64 who met the operational current-Long-COVID definition at their Round 3/1 2024 interview, with valid TOTEXP24
measures.universe: U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized population, adults age 18-64
measures.system_boundary: National all-cause health care expenditures
measures.allowed_interpretation: Calendar-year 2024 gross all-cause health care spending among adults age 18-64 who met the operational current-Long-COVID definition at their Round 3/1 interview in 2024.
limitations: Current-Long-COVID classification is point-in-time at the Round 3/1 2024 interview and does not establish that symptoms persisted throughout calendar year 2024.
Calendar-year expenditures may occur before or after the status interview and are not restricted to periods when symptoms were present.
Descriptive gross spending; no counterfactual comparator or attributable-cost design.

burden_domains.label: Healthcare-work / administrative burden

measures.label: Annualized time on own medical visits / filling prescriptions
measures.interval_type: 95% t CI (Taylor linearization; df=159 from full ESAQ / ESAQWT24F survey design)
measures.denominator: Adults age 18-64 classified operational-current at the earlier Round 3/1 2024 interview, with later ESAQ administration in Panel 28 Round 5 / Panel 29 Round 3, ESAQELIG=1, positive ESAQWT24F, and valid EQMVAM53
measures.universe: U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized adult ESAQ respondent population
measures.system_boundary: National healthcare-work / administrative burden; ESAQ native time domain
measures.allowed_interpretation: Survey-weighted mean of the AHRQ annualized hours-per-year measure for own medical visits and filling prescriptions among later ESAQ respondents in Panel 28 Round 5 / Panel 29 Round 3 who had been classified operational-current at the earlier Round 3/1 2024 interview.
prohibited_interpretation: monetized burden without a separate approved method
limitations: AHRQ top-codes EQMVAM53 at 2080 annualized hours.
AHRQ reports substantial item nonresponse for the ESAQ time-cost questions, especially on paper forms.
EQMVAM53, EQMBAM53, and EQPPAM53 are AHRQ annualized hours-per-year measures derived from the original reported period; they are not necessarily hours observed during calendar year 2024.
This time domain is reported separately and is not added to the other ESAQ time measures.

Operational-current status was measured at the earlier Round 3/1 2024 interview; ESAQ was administered later in Panel 28 Round 5 / Panel 29 Round 3, and that later response does not establish continued current Long COVID at supplement administration.
measures.statistics_method: 95% t CI (Taylor linearization; df=159 from full ESAQ / ESAQWT24F survey design)

prohibited_interpretation: causal effect of Long COVID or diagnostic delay
limitations: Threshold is a distress classification, not a psychiatric diagnosis.
Operational-current status was measured at the earlier Round 3/1 2024 interview; the later PSAQ outcome does not establish continued current Long COVID at supplement administration.
measures.statistics_method: 95% t CI, bounded [0,1] (Taylor linearization; df=159 from full PSAQ / SAQWT24F survey design)
measures.cohort_definition: Operational current Long COVID at the common Round 3/1 2024 interview: adults age 18-64 by AGE31X with positive MEPS person weight, route-aware established Long-COVID history from COVIDEVER31/LCEVER31 questionnaire routing, and COVSYMNOW31 equal to Yes. Structural -1 values are interpreted by routing; RF/DK and unexpected downstream inapplicability remain unresolved. Round-53 status is diagnostic only and never overwrites the primary 2024 anchor.
